review_panel.finding: Audited crates/searchright-assurance/src/lib.rs, crates/searchright-contracts/src/assurance.rs, and contracts/examples/workflow-trace.yaml. Verified finite-state lifecycle trace checking (verify_trace, verify_transition, allowed_transition), detection of discontinuous transitions, and fail-closed rejection of undeclared lifecycle edge skips.

Audited crates/searchright-assurance/src/lib.rs and tests/test_mcp_authority_state_machine.py. Verified that consequential transitions require human approval (requires_human_approval), that agents are unconditionally rejected from closing full-text screening or publishing reports without human approval, and that Hypothesis stateful property fuzzing over searchright-mcp stdio confirms agents cannot record screening decisions without an effect protocol authority token.

Audited contracts/migrations/registry.json, contracts/migrations/github-issue-hierarchy-v1-to-v2.json, and scripts/check_schema_migrations.py. Verified that all multi-version catalog families define explicit non-destructive forward migration plans and rollback contracts, preserving minimum read version and highest write version.

Audited registry default policy in contracts/migrations/registry.json and tests/test_formal_assurance_contract_evolution.py. Verified default_policy mandates unknown_version: reject, destructive_migration: deny, implicit_write_upgrade: deny, backup_required: true, and receipt_required: true.

Upgraded all five Track 26 assertions (T26-A001..T26-A005) to symbol_and_gate_mapped with concrete implementation symbols across searchright-assurance, scripts/check_schema_migrations.py, tests/test_formal_assurance_contract_evolution.py, and tests/test_mcp_authority_state_machine.py in both conductor/tracks/26-formal-assurance-contract-evolution/traceability.json and conductor/traceability-overrides.json (0/5 empty symbols).

Preserved formal assurance gating state without premature completion: implementation_state remains partially_implemented; compiling and running Kani proofs, Loom permutations, Miri/cargo-careful checks, compatibility fixtures, semver/cross-version contract tests, and representative persisted-data migrations remain explicitly open.
